shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab/panel
a snake or serpentine reptile with body running down the surface
justification: Both are low-relief carved panels including a snake-like reptile shown from above/in profile and a bird-headed creature in profile, plus bands of repeated linear hatching, but these are generic correspondences. A is dominated by a single large anthropomorphic winged figure in striding pose with raised hand and staff, filling the whole field, whereas B shows no human figure at all but a stacked register composition of animals (quadrupeds, birds, reptiles) and abstract discs arranged in horizontal tiers, so the compositional schemes and subject matter are fundamentally different.
